author: Tamás Pál
name: Rask Server App
description: An ASP.NET-hosted Rask app — server-side rendering with live updates over a WebSocket.

auth.description: Scaffold a cookie-backed login: a /login form, a credential store, a protected /members page, and the auth wiring.

pwa.description: Make the app an installable PWA: AddRaskPwa serves a web app manifest + Rask's service worker and registers it. Installable + push-capable (Web Push), not an offline app — offline navigations show a static offline.html.
